svg.title: Brass Clockwork Orrery
svg.desc: Planets orbit at true relative sidereal rates (1s = 18.26 days). Each planet's pinion meshes in a fixed internal-toothed ring at its orbit radius and rolls at the exact no-slip rate R/rp (counter-rotating); the central great wheel turns once per Earth year (20 s). The corner movement runs a consistent gear train ending in a 15-tooth escape wheel that ticks once every 0.5 s. Planet day/night shading is real (terminator always faces away from the Sun); surface features sweep with a correct-direction rotation (Venus & Uranus retrograde) but artistic speed.
svg.text: TEMPUS — 1 S ≈ 18.26 D · ORBITS AT TRUE RELATIVE SIDEREAL RATES · ESCAPE 1 TICK / 0.5 S
